Function Call Graph Dashboard

The Function Call Graph Dashboard shows how public functions, shared helpers, and private helpers connect across the package. Review architecture scopes, search for risks, and inspect the selected function call graph when available. Width is direct calls; scope is total runtime assets in the selected scope.
